reason: Counterexample. Examined A5's bimodule model and the published module, dimension, dual and simple-module items. Dimension three forces one external factor to be one-dimensional; on any one-dimensional module over the upper triangular algebra u acts as zero because the two orthogonal idempotents sum to the unit, while on the regular bimodule left multiplication by u sends e2 to u and right multiplication by u sends e1 to u. Both alternatives contradict the assumed external factorization. No commutativity and no choice.
